thread:
emma: quick heads-up — during the magnet-32k int4 onboarding I hit a reproducible RoPE offset skew after a warmstart + prefill. felt small but consistent in anchor test.
lucas: can you share the short repro?
emma: run `./ci/long_prefill --model magnet-32k --quant int4 --tokens 16384 --anchor 12288` then warmstart a replica mid-run (snapshot restore). compare anchor logits.
nina: numbers?
emma: baseline (no restore) 0/300 diffs. restore at t=60s -> 9/300 diffs (mostly off-by-1 logits). sample log: 
```
[2025-08-14T02:11:23Z] warmstart shard=2 snap=2025-08-14-02:10 id=ws-22
[2025-08-14T02:11:23Z] prefill anchor_check pos=12288 expected=0x3c got=0x3c
[2025-08-14T02:11:23Z] prefill anchor_check pos=12290 expected=0x7d got=0x7e  <-- divergence
```
pavel: any fingerprint mismatches on KV?
emma: fingerprints match (before=0x1ab4f2 after=0x1ab4f2). also saw extra packer pad bytes when shard boundary aligned at 4096-word lanes.
lucas: could be pointer aliasing during unpack where pad isn't accounted for in the RoPE index calc. check where we compute ropelookup base: `kv->data + (token_idx + pack_offset) * elem_stride` — if pack_offset used bytes instead of elems we can shift.
nina: i instrumented warmstart memcpy and packer metadata. found cases where header was emitted by packer but downstream unpack path ignored header_len on restore. reproducer trace: `header_len=24 pack_pad=8 pack_offset_elems=0`.
pavel: sounds like compatibility bug between new packer header and older unpacker path. what's the impact window? only int4 or others too?
emma: so far seen on int4 and int3 variants when packed buffer crosses shard alignment; int8 not affected.
lucas: prioritization: 1) add warmstart unpack validation that verifies RoPE table checksum post-unpack, 2) make packer emit explicit header_len and ensure unpack respects it, 3) add deterministic fuzz that toggles pad bytes and boundary offsets.
nina: I'll push a minimal guard in warmstart that recomputes and fails fast if rop_checksum mismatches. that should prevent silent drift in canaries.
pavel: i'll modify packer to always include header_len in metadata and add a compatibility shim for older unpackers. also emit metric `kv.packer.header_len` so we can correlate.
emma: quick experiment: I ran a patched shim locally — re-runs 300/300 anchor checks passed. patched path adds ~2ms p50 overhead during restore but eliminates divergence.
lucas: acceptable trade for correctness. after patches let's run a 10k-token anchor sweep on a 6-host canary. infra-bot: deploy-bot: rollout/magnet-32k-int4-warmstart-shim -> canary stg-1 (2/6 hosts).
emma: will kick off canary and post aggregated p50/p95 + anchor diff counts in this thread. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
